name: Pasul.ro
description: Romanian mental-health marketplace matching clients (Romania + diaspora) with vetted Romanian-speaking psychologists/therapists for online or in-person sessions. Free 15-min discovery call, secure payments, ~219 RON average per session. Founded late 2024, Romania.

mentions.evidence: ~$30.6k L30, ~$306k all-time, MRR listed without active seat count (session marketplace). ~2,000 users claimed, founded Dec 2024, Romania. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Match diaspora patients to same-language clinicians in one country (therapy, dentistry, physio). Trust + language is the moat; payments + matching are the product.

whyItPrints: Country + language vertical healthcare marketplace — Calendesk cousin for therapy demand, not therapist SaaS. Transaction volume (~$30k L30) without seat MRR means take-rate on sessions, not subscriptions.
whyThisMatters:
Romanian speakers who want a therapist, including people who left the country, start with a questionnaire and a WhatsApp chat. Someone on the team reads it and recommends a match. The first meeting is free: 15 minutes on video or audio, so you can see if you get along. After that you book a real session, online or in your city.

Therapists on the site are COPSI-accredited. The team says it checks them by hand and interviews them. They put the average session at 219 lei, from more than 4,000 sessions since January 2025. They say most people hear back within a day, and that 9 in 10 stay with the first therapist. WhatsApp help runs round the clock.

The directory lists a few hundred approved therapists. They quote a start-up.ro line about software in the background and people who still answer at odd hours. The company is in Romania and started in late 2024.
